policy: Explicit emulator balance for incomplete legacy special items. IDs, ranges, AP and source damage intervals are original; missing Land Mine damage, persistent burns, charges and prices below are server policy, not recovered original formulas.
mine_visibility: Planting side only; hostile mines are disclosed by the explosion, not ordinary sight.
flamethrower_fuel: Native item durability is the reservoir: a 9-AP burst requires at least 9 durability and consumes 9 through normal weapon wear (existing premium half-wear applies); repair replenishes it. No invented ammunition template ID.
burn_policy: Molotov creates a ground-fire disk at the authoritative scattered impact. It uses original item radius and the319 burn policy damage10/turns3; expiry follows the maximum actor turn generation (three battle rounds including the throw round). Entering/crossing and turn-start cause at most one armor-mitigated10 raw damage per actor generation; overlapping fires never multiply it. Initial impact suppresses an additional same-generation fire tick. Flamethrower retains two victim-turn burns. Ground fire persists if the thrower dies; reconnect cannot reset expiry or tick receipts.
